craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of workshop disputation — ends-first reasoning. Clay-lump watching potter (nature potter-watching). Rejected: (a) watching→awaiting → killed: watching is active. Read aloud: FROM the-CLAY-lump … WATCH-ing THE-pott-ER.

lines: From the clay-lump made of pradhāna, such-natured by nature —
own-nature now, this of this, watching the potter.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pradhānamayamṛtpiṇḍādeva tādṛksvabhāvataḥ atha svabhāva eṣo'sya yatkulālādyapekṣaṇam

reads_against.argmap: What of clay-lump nature? → Own-nature looks to potter etc.: clay-lump nature potter-watching.
c1_essence: Potter necessary, nature watching, helpers insufficient, wisdom and will required, sufficiency tested (vv28-33).
Array excels by ends; Lord and un-Lord fenced off atomically; pradhāna will-less yet person-aim-ness stands (vv34-36).
